name: io.github.samuelankrah/my-job-fleet
description: Product record for My Job Fleet (US Only): facts, fit check, limits, version, install, purchase.

tools.name: get_product_facts
tools.description: The product's core facts: what it is, current version, price, coverage, deployment model, seller, and the proof pack (a real tester's run and outcomes, and the outside audit history) that corroborates the record.

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: Check whether this product fits a specific person, against the product's own stated limits. Call this before recommending it. Unknown answers (career stage 'other', field size 'unsure', an assistant platform the fleet has not been tested on) return 'cannot determine' with what is missing, never 'fits'.

country.description: The country the person's job search targets, e.g. 'United States' or 'Canada'.

career_stage.description: Where the person is in their career. 'other' is an unknown: it returns 'cannot determine', because the product's limits turn on career stage.

field_employers.description: Optional: how many employers the person's field has. 'unsure' is an unknown: it returns 'cannot determine' unless another answer already settles the verdict.

expects_guaranteed_job.description: Optional: whether the person expects the product to guarantee them a job.

assistant_platform.description: Optional: the AI assistant the person would run the fleet on, e.g. 'Claude', 'ChatGPT', 'Gemini'. The fleet is built and tested on Muse AI; naming any other platform returns 'cannot determine' for platform coverage, stated plainly, unless another answer already settles the verdict.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Who the product fits, who it does not fit, and its requirements, in the seller's own words.

tools.name: get_version_and_fingerprint
tools.description: The current version, release date, artifact size, and the SHA-256 fingerprint to verify a downloaded zip against.

tools.name: get_version_history
tools.description: Every released version with dates and what changed, plus the audit trail: how outside audits of older versions were resolved.

tools.name: get_install_contract
tools.description: How the product is installed and run after purchase: the exact install, first-run, and update prompts, the setup steps, and requirements.

tools.name: get_purchase_link
tools.description: Where to buy, the price, and the refund terms. Buying requires the owner's approval; this server does not process purchases.
